title: Foam Daddy Storefront - Production Publish Readiness (Frontend)

requirements.summary: Harden frontend publish readiness: keep public routes unauthenticated, keep /admin gated by Internet Identity + role checks, ensure SPA deep links recover correctly after 404 fallback, and ensure Share copies the live deployed URL.
acceptanceCriteria: A production build is created and released as the live/published version (not a temporary draft).
Visiting the homepage ("/") does not require login and loads successfully.
Public routes (/products, /product/:productId, /cart, /checkout, /request-quote) are accessible without authentication and function end-to-end.
Admin routes (/admin/*) still require Internet Identity authentication and proper role checks.
SPA deep links work after publish (unknown routes fall back to the app shell via the existing 404 fallback).
The Share button copies the deployed (non-localhost) URL correctly when tested on the live deployment.

file_operations.description: Update ShareButton to copy the full current URL (including path + search + hash when present) so live deployments copy the correct non-localhost address for deep-linked pages. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add startup redirect restoration logic that reads the sessionStorage key set by frontend/public/404.html (e.g., redirectPath) and restores the intended deep link via History API before the router mounts, ensuring SPA deep links work after publish.

Align the 404 SPA fallback behavior with the app’s deep-link restoration logic (ensure the stored redirect path format matches what frontend/src/main.tsx expects, and that the redirect preserves search/hash appropriately).

Confirm /admin remains gated behind Internet Identity login plus admin role checks, and ensure unauthorized users see a clear Access Denied experience without impacting public routes. Use the selected 'authorization' component patterns for auth/role-gated UI behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Complete and update the production publish checklist and steps for a non-expiring live deployment, including verifying: public routes work without authentication, /admin remains gated behind Internet Identity + roles, SPA deep links work via 404 fallback, and Share copies the live deployed URL.
